content:
# S3 Logs Bucket + IAM Permissions

I'll add the logs bucket and permissions to both environments. Since this is a bare stack with no shared base, each directory has fully independent manifests.

`dev/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
spec:
  bucket: myapp-logs-dev
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`dev/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-user-logs-policy
spec:
  userName: myapp-user
  policyName: myapp-logs-access-dev
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

`prod/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
spec:
  bucket: myapp-logs-prod
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`prod/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-role-logs-policy
spec:
  roleName: myapp-role
  policyName: myapp-logs-access-prod
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

---

## Notes

- **Field names in Policy spec**: Adjust `userName: myapp-user` and `roleName: myapp-role` to match your existing User and Role names.
- **Deployment**: Apply both new files per environment:  
  ```bash
  kubectl apply -f dev/logs-bucket.yaml -f dev/logs-policy.yaml
  kubectl apply -f prod/logs-bucket.yaml -f prod/logs-policy.yaml
  ```
- **Principle of least privilege**: Each policy grants only `s3:GetObject` and `s3:PutObject` on the logs bucket ARN; the existing assets bucket policy is left untouched.
- **Independence**: Dev and prod manifests are completely separate—no overlays or shared files—so changes to one environment do not affect the other.
